discovery.result: log Body_size_mm negatively predicts wet-recruitment log odds
discovery.note: This was a frozen secondary trait screen, not the original primary trait hypothesis.

validation_source.forbidden: No other Huang morphological trait is tested or inspected for association with wet recruitment in this validation family.

match_order: frozen genus alias only if exact fails

body_size_summary.primary: median positive finite SVL across all source rows for a species
body_size_summary.adult_sensitivity: median positive finite SVL among Sex in {M,F}; exclude J and unknown sex

models.primary: inverse-variance weighted least squares: log_odds ~ log(median_SVL_mm), HC3 covariance
models.adult_sensitivity: same model using adult-only median SVL
models.family_adjusted_sensitivity: primary median SVL with C(Family), only if >=18 species and residual df >=10

decision.validation_pass: Primary beta < 0 and 95% CI excludes 0; adult sensitivity beta must also be < 0 when estimable.
decision.family_adjusted: Reported as phylogenetic-structure sensitivity, not required for primary validation pass.

interpretation_boundary: Independent validation refers to an independently compiled morphological database, not an independent set of frog species.
Body size may proxy multiple life-history axes; validation alone does not establish a mechanism.
No phylogenetic comparative model is fitted; family adjustment is only a coarse sensitivity.
